interpretation: No quality improvement was observed: pool retention stayed at 90/252, while Top1 fell from 20/252 to 18/252. The two worsened conditions belong to one scene, so they are not two independent scene outcomes.
limitations: 252 conditions come from 63 scenes and are not 252 independent examples.
Loss ineligibility reflects the original survival objective, which excludes full-span edges; it is not automatically an input-method failure or proof of missing dictionary coverage.
This is a development evaluation, not the final evaluation set or Windows product acceptance.
The model has received only two training updates; these results do not establish convergence or the final capability of the approach.
Absolute historical non-overlap between upstream public pretraining and the final evaluation corpus has not been certified.
scope: Fixed student_dev split, disjoint from all qualified training IDs; original public embedding with candidate-generator head at steps 0 and 2. Not the earlier H128 reranker evaluation.
